# Command list

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_command_list.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool this server exposes: **236**, grouped by the module that defines it.

**Hints** are the four MCP annotations: **R**ead-only, **D**estructive (not purely additive, in MCP's sense), **I**dempotent, **O**pen-world; `-` means false. **Safeguard** says what happens when an agent calls the tool: see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md#the-safeguard). Any write call is also held when its arguments carry text another person wrote, a file tool is held when its path leaves `files/outbox` and `files/downloads`, and a call is refused outright when it would touch the approval channel, the safeguard's own files, the rest of the installation or the state directory.
